v2.7.0 — 🔐 APP VAULT:

Device-level app locks, PIN-gated. Lock any app and it CANNOT start — not from the launcher, not from another app, not even after a reboot. The lock is an OS-level state: it survives reboots AND the Empire being uninstalled.

🔒 Tap any app to lock it into the Vault (instant freeze)
🔑 4-6 digit PIN required to unlock or remove (salted SHA-256, stored locally only)
🔄 AUTO RE-LOCK: any vault app found unlocked freezes again the moment the Vault opens — your phone re-arms itself
🔒 Lock All in one tap
🩺 Built on the battle-tested v2.6.x freeze engine with release artillery + truth-read verification

Honest limits (shown in the app): a factory reset clears every device-level state — that wall belongs to Google (FRP), not to any app. Everything short of a reset is defended.

Same cert, updates in place over v2.6.7.
